fail.name: scrub-prop-5
fail.problems: At 1x on both dirt and plains, the three large tumbleweeds read as solid perforated balls or coiled shells, not dry wiry clumps. The 4x/8x views show broad continuous khaki ribbons and large dark enclosed holes, especially across the big rear ball and left ball. Redraw the interior as finer, irregular crossing twigs with more genuine transparent gaps and broken outer strands; reduce the broad solid bands and repeated ring/spiral construction while preserving the three unequal clumps and footprint.

fail.name: scrub-prop-6
fail.problems: The dry gully reads as a graphic beveled lightning crack: a conspicuous pale ribbon runs along the angular branch edges against a dark, hard-edged trough. It remains visibly pasted on the plains at 1x/4x; at 8x the broad flat bands and abrupt step-shaped banks lack an eroded channel reading. Replace the continuous bright bevel with irregular, broken, lower-contrast bank shading; give the connected channel a varied width, taper the tributaries, and keep the substrate visible with translucent earth/shadow tones.

fail.name: scrub@winter-prop-5
fail.problems: At 1x on both dirt and plains, the three large tumbleweeds read as solid perforated balls or coiled shells, not dry wiry clumps. The 4x/8x views show broad continuous khaki ribbons and large dark enclosed holes, especially across the big rear ball and left ball. Redraw the interior as finer, irregular crossing twigs with more genuine transparent gaps and broken outer strands; reduce the broad solid bands and repeated ring/spiral construction while preserving the three unequal clumps and footprint. Reapply the snow as small upper-surface catches on the corrected twigs; the current snow stripes trace and reinforce the same thick shell-like bands.

fail.name: scrub@winter-prop-6
fail.problems: On winter plains at 1x/4x, the gully breaks into separate flat grey wedges toward the lower-right instead of reading as one drainage channel. At 8x, the broad pale frost/bevel crosses and washes out the trough at junctions, while the hard angular rims retain the summer lightning-crack look. Keep a visibly connected, tapering depression through the junctions and lower outlet; replace the broad bright bevel with sparse frost along irregular banks and lower-contrast translucent wall shading. Preserve the same channel layout as the corrected summer version.
